state:
Goal `core-signal-and-4-more`. `Core\Signal`, `Core\Signature` and now `Core\SignedCookie` are green.
`Core\SignedCookie::seal` and `::open` have all their feature proofs: an `about.md` each, three
examples each, one attack each, one bench each, and a member-level Rust test each carrying `covers:`
at the foot of `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/signed_cookie.rs`. The class has a card, is off
`CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`, and both member cards are rewritten in the plain voice. Neither attack
found a bug. `open` checks an older key's length only when the walk reaches it; the card and the
helper's doc now say so. Nothing is blocked. Still red in stage 2: `Core\Socket` and
`Core\Socket\Message`.

next.title: one slice per feature
next.note: one file set: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/socket.rs` and its proof trees under `core/Socket/` and `core/Socket-Message/`. Both classes live in the one file, so take the class cards together.

items.text: **`Core\Socket::send`, `::sendBytes`, `::receive`** — owe examples, hostile, perf, and one more Novis case each (`receive` owes two), plus `Core\Socket`'s class card (`doc: None`, and the class is on `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`). These are instance members, so a Rust test needs a `covers:` marker. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/socket.rs:223`

**`Core\Socket\Message::text`, `::bytes`, `::value`** — owe examples, hostile, perf, two tests each, and `Core\Socket\Message`'s class card. `rule:testing/feature-proofs`. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/socket.rs:476`

backlog: `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group '<class>'` must run after the last edit to the implementing file, `fmt` included, or the gate reads the figure as stale — `rule:testing/member-perf-ledger`.
